name: @dsh-external/dsh-session-pulse
description: Session status panel for the pentest / code-audit presets: header progress chip (task-list projection with completion bar), subagent chip with a right-side subagent directory drawer (running/finished groups, click a name to open that subagent session), and a left-center prompt rail listing user prompts with hover preview and click-to-locate on the chat anchor.
author: Saker contributors
